title: The Hard Cipher
author: Marguerite Hartwell
blurb: Petra Crane, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
